title: DLSA Dindigul Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 30 Para Legal Volunteer Posts
description: The District Legal Services Authority (DLSA Dindigul) has announced the official notification for the recruitment of 30 Para Legal Volunteer posts. Candidates who have passed 10th can grab this chance and apply for the DLSA Dindigul Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
